messages:
matt: Heads-up — eu-west-1 queue depth spiked for orca-13b-v0 and redwood-moderate: combined queue ~8k, p50 latency creeping from 210ms -> 480ms in last 10m. anyone on call?

oncall-bot: ALERT: queue_depth > 5000 in eu-west-1 for model=orca-13b-v0; top_endpoint=/v1/generate; active_gpus=18/32; inflight_tokens=12M; estimated_clear_time=180m. link=https://monitoring.redwood/alerts/1772001234

sara: I'm pulling per-host metrics now. Any recent deploys to that region?
matt: No deploys from infra side. Product didn't push model weights AFAIK.
oliver: Not a deploy. Networking reported a brief packetloss window at 1772000900 but BGP looked stable after 5m. Might be slow kernels on some GPU nodes causing backlog.
dina: Triage proposal (immediate):
- set region admission_control to 80% of normal for eu-west-1
- apply per-model limits for orca-13b-v0: max_concurrent=600, queue_limit=2000
- enable fallback routing for low-priority traffic to us-east-1
- evict/terminate any >120s warmup jobs
Commands: `redwoodctl admission set --region eu-west-1 --pct 80`
`redwoodctl model set --model orca-13b-v0 --max-concurrent 600 --queue-limit 2000`
matt: Also enable fallback to orca-13b-q8 (quantized) for latency >600ms. That should reduce per-token CPU pressure.
oliver: Warning: cross-region spill will spin up GPUs in us-east-1 and add egress. Quick cost back-of-envelope: 2000 req/s spill -> ~200 full-gpu-hours/hr =~ $2.1k/hr in worst-case. Be explicit with cost owners before big failovers.
sara: I'll flip the admission control and toggle KV prefix caching aggressive mode (reduce cache expiry to 90s) to lower token regen. Doing now.
sara: Done — admission_control applied and prefix cache tightened. Current stats: queue depth -> 4.3k, p50=340ms, p95=820ms. Trending down. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/regions/eu-west-1/queues?alert=1772001234
matt: Nice. Can you also list top callers (api keys / teams) so we can throttle noisy tenants?
sara: Top callers: team-search (45%), public-api (23%), unknown-short-lived keys (12%). I'll apply soft rate limits to public-api and contact search PM.
dina: I'll draft a short runbook entry and add an automatic routing rule: if queue_depth(model=orca-13b-v0,region=eu-west-1) > 3000 for >2m then set route spill_to=us-east-1 pct=30.
oliver: Postmortem checklist: kernel versions, recent spot reclaim events, quantization compatibility test results, any tokenizer/byte-level changes, and admission_control thresholds.
oncall-bot: INCIDENT 1772001234 acknowledged by sara. Incident channel created: #incidents/1772001234.
matt: Thanks team. We'll keep monitoring for 1h and then schedule a short postmortem if queue doesn't stay below 1k. :thumbsup:
sara: I'll follow up with the caller throttles and PM outreach.
dina: I also created a temporary alert tweak to avoid noisy flaps (suppress if decaying >10% in 5m).
matt: Closing the loop here — current queue 1.9k and falling. If it stabilizes we'll add the routing rule to prod tomorrow during low-traffic window.
oncall-bot: RESOLVED: alert 1772001234 resolved at 1772001898.
